Digital Force Technologies (DFT) builds SeraphimOS platform software that enables distributed mission systems to operate reliably at the tactical edge. The Software Engineer will develop and maintain platform services and runtime components, engineer resilient data flows, and improve software deployment, observability, security, and performance.

Establish maintainable interfaces and engineering patterns shared by multiple mission applications
